annotations.title: Get the text of a Bible passage

description: Returns the exact text of a Bible passage in the World English Bible (WEB), with a WEB credit. The WEB's wording differs from other translations (for example its John 3:16 says "only born Son"). Use this when the user asks to quote a passage or give the words, or the exact text is needed to answer a question, for example "John 3:16", "Psalm 23" or "1 Corinthians 13:4-7". Up to 200 verses per call; a longer range stops there and says how to continue. It returns a known passage by reference; it does not search by words and does not provide other translations.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verses, e.g. "John 3:16", "John 3:16-18", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:28-9:3", "Jude 5".

name: get_bible_passage

omittedVerses.description: Requested verses that the WEB prints only in footnotes.
